[attribute-accept]
=== `@accept` XInclude Accept Header

An Accept Header for an HTTP request (if any) for the resource being included. See the W3C XInclude documentation (https://www.w3.org/TR/xinclude/).

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-xi-include,`<xi:include>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The text of the Accept header.
| Restriction| This attribute is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
